column1: # The hand-written part of the strip's emoji keywords, part of this project (data/emoji/README.md).
# keyword <TAB> append|replace|skip <TAB> emoji, best first (at most five are used).
# append: the emoji goes after the word ("ok 👌"); replace: the emoji takes the word's place
# ("haha" -> "😂", "cà phê" -> "☕"); skip: a CLDR name left out. A keyword of one word fires
# only as typed (marks and all, any case); one of several words also when typed without marks.
# A line here takes the place of CLDR's for the same keyword.
# Laughing, crying and other sounds: the emoji says it instead.
# Emoticons typed with symbols: the emoji in their place.
# Words typed without marks that are worth an emoji: few, since each fires for every word
# typed with those letters ("hoa" is also hòa, hóa).
# Food, drink and pets: CLDR's under other names, or the emoji chat uses first.
# CLDR names left out: everyday words and times of day, which would fire in ordinary text.
